project_name.justification: The text states that Panther Minerals Inc. has executed an option for the right to purchase an undivided 100% interest in the East Brouillan property.

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified as: "Panther Minerals Inc. (“Panther Minerals” or the “Company”) (CSE:PURR)".

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the buyer, Panther Minerals, is identified in the text: "Mr. Robert Birmingham, Chief Executive Officer" and also quoted: "stated CEO Rob Birmingham.”

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The agreement is for the right to acquire the full interest: "the Company may acquire a 100% interest in the Property".

primary_commodity.justification: The text describes the project's potential as follows: "The East Brouillan Property contains geology favourable for both polymetallic VMS and gold mineralization".

verified_article_link.justification: No verifiable article link was provided in the source text. The text contains links to company homepages or images, but not to the specific news release.

currency.justification: The acquiring company, Panther Minerals Inc., is listed on the Canadian Securities Exchange (CSE), and a separate transaction mentioned in the text for the Huber Heights Property is explicitly denominated in CAD: "cash payments to the Optionor of CAD$150,000". This implies the currency for the main transaction is also CAD.

cash_payments_raw.justification: The terms for the East Brouillan property do not include a cash payment component. A cash payment of CAD$150,000 is mentioned, but it is for a different transaction: "the Huber Heights Property".

share_payments_raw.justification: The transaction is being recorded using the number of shares and price per share (Priority 2), so this field is null.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The transaction is being recorded using the number of shares and price per share (Priority 2), so this field is null.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: The agreement terms state the company will be "issuing an aggregate of 10,000,000 common shares in the capital of the Company". This is composed of 5,000,000 shares at signing and 5,000,000 on the first anniversary.

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants are mentioned as part of the transaction terms for the East Brouillan property.

option_payments_raw.justification: No options are mentioned as part of the payment terms for the East Brouillan property.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued but not an explicit price. Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote section: 'Last: 0.02'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The exploration commitment is specified as a monetary value, not in meters of drilling.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: The terms of the agreement state that Panther Minerals must be "completing $2,000,000 of work expenditures".

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The seller has retained a royalty as part of the deal: "The Company has granted to the Optionor a 2% net-smelter returns royalty (the “NSR”)".

coverage_area_raw.justification: The text states the property "comprises 14 claims" but does not provide a specific area in units like hectares or square kilometers.

coverage_area_unit.justification: No coverage area was specified in the text.

resource_size.justification: The text does not state a mineral resource for the East Brouillan property itself. It mentions resources for nearby deposits (B26, Selbaie, Fenelon), but not on the subject property, which is described as 'underexplored'.

buyer_ticker_and_exchange.justification: The buyer is identified in the text as "Panther Minerals Inc. (“Panther Minerals” or the “Company”) (CSE:PURR)".
